text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While watching the horse girls train, my eyes landed on Gran Alegria and the others.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, my strides feel even more powerful than usual! It's all thanks to everyone training alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't mention it.
Pacing alongside fellow classmates has nothing but benefits, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Still, is it just my imagination...?
It felt like Gran-chan was different from usual...!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I believe I understand as well.
She seemed brimming with fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yup! You know the mock races coming up soon, right?
That big event where they run all kinds of races over several days.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Actually~... I registered for 3 different categories!
The 1200m sprint, the 2000m medium distance, and of course the 1600m mile!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
! Running in different distance categories...
That's quite a bold challenge...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Different race distances demand completely different skill sets.
Yet she registered for three of them...
choice_data_list: You're not pushing yourself too hard, are you?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: No need to worry! Whether it's sprint or medium distance, I'll be totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Because I'm the strongest miler!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: If you're a truly strong miler, a little difference in distance doesn't matter at all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's 0.75 miles at 1200m or 1.25 miles at 2000m!
I can definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
That sounds just like you, Gran-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Your pure devotion to the mile remains unchanged as ever.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
—Nine... ty!
Phew, barbell squats done!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, what intense weight...!
To think you're pushing your lower body this hard.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ You bet!
Explosive power is absolutely vital for miles, after all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelming speed, plus the stamina to maintain that speed—
The mile is an amazing distance where you can't afford to lack either.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The horse girl who can shine brightest in the mile is stronger than anyone!
That's what I truly believe!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because you're that kind of girl, Gran-chan...
that you can take on any distance.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yep! So I'm gonna prove it...
That the mile is the absolute strongest!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
—And now, they've entered the final stretch!
Who will be the one to claim victory
in this mock race's 1200m division—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! One runner is charging up from behind
with incredible speed! Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Hyaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's Gran Alegriaaa!!
That closing speed is simply on another dimension!
She crosses the finish liiine!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent 1st place in the turf sprint division!
And what's more, incredibly—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day, she displayed a breathtaking run in a 2000m race as well!
Does distance mean nothing to this horse girl~!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I did it...! I did it—!
How's that, this is the strongest miler—!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Love-chan, Chrono-chan, Bouquet-san!
How was it? Did you see my run!?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text: Of course! Unleashing your spurt with such impeccable timing across any distance... It's pure genius!

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
A single-minded, truly overwhelming run.
Your deep love for the mile was received loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Still, we can't afford to be intimidated.
...We aren't going to lose either, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ahaha!
Yeah, of course!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do is forge straight ahead on this path!
So... it's a match, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Gran Alegria's dazzling performance,
I spotted her preparing for another mock race.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now then, today's mock race is—
The Mile division, Turf 1600m!
They're sure to put on a spectacular race for us!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here...! My stage!
The place where I want to shine the brightest!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I don't care who my opponents are.
In this race, I will definitely not lose!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
The queen of miles is none other than me—
Gran Alegria!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So keep your eyes on us, okay? The mock race we're running next... Medium distance, 2400m.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: We're gonna light a fire in your heart like never before♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's race...! 
Of course! I have to watch from the very front row!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's a race between my generational rivals, after all!
I'll be sure to burn it into my memory!
